integrity: Complete self-contained deterministic C++17 verifier, exact complete list of 160 quadruple fibers, and independent prefix-sum comparison in every nonsingleton key bucket; no reliance on probabilistic hash uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Exact, exhaustive finite classification only for binary linear words of length 23 using all nonempty substring compositions with multiplicity. The 2010/2014 works already introduced noninterleaved confusion at this length. General lengths, different observations, independent proof audit, and exhaustive global literature priority are not claimed.
title: Complete length-\(23\) binary substring-composition ambiguity census
